summary: Tested floating preferences bubble feature for theme selection and default page. All features working: FAB button visible at bottom-right, panel opens with Themes and Default Page tabs, 3 templates displayed (Clean Blue, Dark Theme, Neon Test), theme selection persists to localStorage, default page preference works on reload, auto-rotate toggle functions correctly. Backend API /api/design-templates/public returns 3 templates. CSS text color variables (--content-text-color, --card-heading-color) are being set on main content area.
critical_code_review_comments: UserPreferences.js correctly implements floating FAB at fixed bottom-right position with z-index 9999
localStorage key 'mlbl_user_prefs' stores pinnedTemplateId, useRotating, and defaultPage
Layout.js passes onStyleChange prop to UserPreferences for theme application
App.js line ~397-404 correctly reads mlbl_user_prefs on load and navigates to defaultPage
App.js line ~510-523 fetches pinned template from public API and applies style on initial load
index.css lines 133-167 define CSS rules for .main-content-area that use CSS custom properties
seed_data_creation: Used existing 3 design templates (Clean Blue, Dark Theme, Neon Test) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: User preferences are stored in localStorage under 'mlbl_user_prefs' key. The floating FAB button uses data-testid='preferences-fab' and panel uses data-testid='preferences-panel'. Template buttons use data-testid='template-{uuid}'. Use page.evaluate to click the FAB button as Playwright force=True doesn't reliably trigger React state.

details: FAB button visible at bottom-right corner (24px from edges)
data-testid='preferences-fab' present for testing
Click opens preferences panel with animation
Panel has z-index 9998, button has z-index 9999
Themes tab (data-testid='prefs-tab-theme') is default selected
Shows Auto-Rotate toggle (data-testid='toggle-rotating')
Shows Next Theme button (data-testid='cycle-theme-btn')
Displays 3 template previews with mini colored boxes
Template buttons have data-testid='template-{id}'
Clicking template saves pinnedTemplateId to localStorage
localStorage key: mlbl_user_prefs
After selecting Neon Test: {'pinnedTemplateId':'34754279-...','useRotating':false}
Theme visually applies immediately (nav colors, content background change)
On page reload, console shows 'User pinned theme: Neon Test' and theme is re-applied
Toggle switches between rotating and persistent mode
When enabled: useRotating becomes true, pinnedTemplateId becomes null
When disabled: useRotating becomes false
Toggle visual state changes (background color indicates state)
Default Page tab (data-testid='prefs-tab-page') shows 4 options
Options: Home, Events & Schedule, Standings, Help & Docs
Each option has data-testid='default-page-{id}'
Selecting Events saves defaultPage:'events' to localStorage
On reload, console shows 'Applying default page preference: events' and navigates to Events page
GET /api/design-templates/public returns 200 OK
Returns exactly 3 templates: Clean Blue, Dark Theme, Neon Test
Each template has id, name, style object
Neon Test has 15 style properties with extensive visual customization
CSS custom properties set on <main> element via inline style
--card-heading-color: #1f2937 (computed from websiteStyle.cardHeadingColor)
--content-text-color: #374151 (computed from websiteStyle.contentTextColor)
Headings in .main-content-area use var(--card-heading-color) from index.css rules
Body text uses var(--content-text-color) via CSS rule selectors
